requirements.acceptance: Personal connections for user, client, trainer and admin; effective tool access is the intersection of grant, current role, object access and feature eligibility
Hermes plus one independently implemented MCP client complete the same synthetic read/propose/revoke workflow
Local inference supports tested Hermes and OpenAI-compatible local runtimes; induced model failure makes zero cloud fallback calls
Agent output only creates a draft/proposal; an authorized human reviews the exact version before activation; replay causes no duplicate effect
Pseudonymous allowlisted context only; no names, contacts, raw notes, secrets or private operator memory; revoked access denies the next request
Pair, inspect capabilities, pause, revoke, re-pair and handle sleeping devices in the app; no inbound public port required
Consulting setup has an optional onboarding service and customer-owned credentials; support access is separate, scoped, time-limited and revocable
Chosen exercise count and rotation reach generation unchanged after validation; omitted values retain current behavior
Session length, equipment, schedule, goals, split, preferences, restrictions and programming controls persist and affect the plan; unsupported combinations return explicit violations
Ordered blocks and typed per-set prescriptions round-trip through save/load/PDF/logger without losing grouping, units, warmups or cooldowns
Exercise Rolodex keeps search, filters, Library/In plan, undo and Teach Mode; richer comparisons and substitutions preserve canonical exercise identity
Whole-program editing preserves unedited weeks; edits explain session time, planned volume and expected progression without inventing logged progress
Current, draft, backup, blended, template and archived plans remain distinguishable; existing revision conflicts/PDF invalidation remain enforced
Backup refresh previews differences and preserves a recoverable prior revision; promotion uses the existing transactional lifecycle
Blending explains source lineage and validates merged constraints before creating a new draft; originals are unchanged
Any client switch, timeout, duplicate request, cancellation or access change prevents cross-client results and silent overwrite
All modes work by keyboard and at 320/390/414/768/1024/1440/1920/2560/3840 CSS widths; 44px targets, 200% zoom and reduced motion
Feature-flag rollback, schema compatibility, isolated restore and privacy-safe diagnostics are proven before release
Default Coach without API setup; connection owner distinct from target.
Personal S256 PKCE owner/session binding, encrypted key storage, rotation and revocation.
One atomic root-task reservation across tabs/workers/retries/children; 105 attempts cannot admit 105 calls.
Unknown price/allowance/acceptance blocks another paid dispatch; no implicit fallback.
Final payload protects identity/medical/child data and every modality; withdrawal terminal.
Local-only tasks never call disallowed cloud services under induced failures.
Current role/assignment/consent governs every enrichment/dispatch/save; agents cannot change policy.
Exact prescription diff and retained state across mobile panes and Program Map.
Every implemented slice and final state has current v3 workflow evidence.
